status.label: Status
status.tooltip: Whether helper plugins are installed and working.
status.intro: Required plugins must be installed and loaded for traveling and aethernet teleports. Optional ones unlock BOCCHI AI (a BossMod / BMR autorotation preset for targeting and movement — not a job rotation, and not the legacy ai:on) and a separate job autorotation (Wrath / Rotation Solver) — you only need one from each group. “Linked” means BOCCHI can talk to that plugin.
status.optional_intro: Pick one plugin per group (either is fine).
